introHtml: Custom 12 oz hot cold packs offer a practical, portable solution for treating minor aches and pains on the go. The 12 oz packs can be heat-activated or cold-activated, making them versatile for both muscle relaxation and injury recovery. Decorate with your logo for a thoughtful, functional giveaway that shows you care about employee or customer wellbeing.
